chapters.title: Chapter 1972 - Moving through the Myriad Winds like an Agile Dragon
paragraphs: Yu Huafan could no longer remain calm. Although Jiang Chen had only been brought into the Dragon Hall recently, he was well aware that Jiang Chen was one of Feng Jingyang’s favourite disciples, otherwise, Feng Jingyang wouldn’t have let Jiang Chen come along with him.
If Jiang Chen died here, he certainly wouldn’t be able to provide a decent explanation for Feng Jingyang, and he would feel tremendously sad for the loss as well.

However, the situation was no longer under his control. He didn’t even have the chance to speak. Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign was serious about his decision. The fact that Jiang Chen and Xiao Wangqing were heading into the terrifying gales was already unchangeable.
“What should I do? Junior Brother Jiang is being too reckless.” Yu Huafan spoke worriedly.

“There’s no need to worry. Jiang Chen never do things that he has no confidence in. In other words, he will be able to pass through those winds,” said Big Yellow with incomparable confidence, his face full of calmness.
“Alright, but I have no idea where you have gotten that confidence from.”

Yu Huafan sighed. He knew that not even a Third Grade Great Sovereign could go through those winds. Although he had been tremendously impressed by Jiang Chen’s capabilities, Jiang Chen was merely an intermediate Immortal Venerable, and the outcome of intruding onto the platform was imaginable.
However, Big Yellow’s confidence had relieved some of his concerns.

Currently, Jiang Chen and Xiao Wangqing were already standing at the edge of the grand formation. Xiao Wangqing’s facial expression had changed entirely as he stared at the sea of winds, knowing that his body would be sliced to a million pieces if he rushed into it straightaway.
“Jiang Chen, step down now. I, Xiao Wangqing, am willing to die in this trial. You still have a bright future. You don’t have to risk your life with me,” Xiao Wangqing said.

He really couldn’t bear seeing Jiang Chen follow him into the Myriad Wind Formation. This was too unfair to Jiang Chen. In order to realise his wish, he would rather sacrifice his life. Jiang Chen, on the other hand, was a heaven-defying and promising figure. If Jiang Chen died today, he wouldn’t be able to rest in peace.
“Senior Xiao, when did you learn how to nag like a grandmother?”
Jiang Chen smiled, and then grabbed Xiao Wangqing’s arm, heading straight into the grand formation with a swoosh of his body.
All of a sudden, countless terrifying winds in the form of dragons came from all directions. Each wave of wind was as destructive as a giant blade, intending to cut the two intruders in half.

“Senior Xiao, I’ll enshroud you with my qi. Based on my observation, this grand formation is at least a few dozen miles. The deeper we go, the terrifying it will become. You just follow by my side. The energy radiating from my body will guide you. Remember not to move at your own will, otherwise death is just a step away,” warned Jiang Chen in a serious tone.
“Okay.”

Xiao Wangqing nodded, and allowed Jiang Chen’s energy and qi to surround his body. After entering the Myriad Wind Formation, he realised how terrifying these gales were. Given his strength, he wouldn’t be able to get past a tenth of the distance.

He also realized that it was no longer meaningful to ask Jiang Chen to back away now. Knowing that Jiang Chen was proficient in the Great Void Technique, it would be a mistake not to follow Jiang Chen’s order.

Furthermore, there was already no turning back for the two of them. Although Xiao Wangqing had no idea whether they could get past the Myriad Winds and meet the saintess, he believed that he couldn’t die here. What he needed to do now was to stay calm and do as Jiang Chen said.
Jiang Chen was a creator of miracles, which meant that they might really have a chance.
Countless eyes were now focused on the grand formation. Heavenly Peng, in particular, was focusing on Jiang Chen unblinkingly, as if he didn’t want to miss a move of Jiang Chen.
Everyone was eager to find out how long those two can last.
“Once the Myriad Wind Grand Formation is provoked, it will attack like countless beasts. How far do you think they can reach?”

“Jiang Chen is just an intermediate Immortal Venerable. While Xiao Wangqing is just a newly-advanced First Grade Great Sovereign. In my opinion, I’m afraid that they can’t even reach the tenth of the formation.”

“I have the same thought. It’s already considered not bad if they can travel roughly a tenth of the distance of the grand formation. It’s virtually impossible for them to get past the entire formation, unless a miracle happens.”
Comments and remarks filled the air. To them, this show was so much better than the previous singing and dancing. It was a real eye-opener to them.

In the grand formation, Jiang Chen’s sparkling eyes gazed into the depths of the myriad of gales while circulating the Great Soul Derivation Technique and Great Divination Art. Of course, the Great Void Technique was the ability he needed to get past these winds.
Through the Great Divination Art, he was able to calculate the trajectories of these winds, which would allow him to get pass every wave of wind with ease.

After a moment of observation, a faint smile could be seen on his face as he had already discovered all the tracks and arrangements of the wind waves. Next, he only needed the Great Void Technique to get past them.
To an outsider, getting past the formation was as difficult as climbing the sky, but this was nothing to Jiang Chen who possessed the Great Void Technique and Great Divination Art.

He knew that this was a test from Heavenly Peng. He also knew that Heavenly Peng was extremely familiar with the Great Void Technique. The fact that Heavenly Peng asked him to get past the grand formation indicated that as long as he had mastered the Great Void Technique, he would be able to get through the winds with ease.
“Senior Xiao, let’s go.”
Jiang Chen moved, seals forming below his feet. Moving like an agile dragon, bringing Xiao Wangqing along, he travelled three miles in a blink. Neither of those gales of wind touched the two of them.

sentences.text: Yu Huafan could no longer remain calm.

Although Jiang Chen had only been brought into the Dragon Hall recently, he was well aware that Jiang Chen was one of Feng Jingyang’s favourite disciples, otherwise, Feng Jingyang wouldn’t have let Jiang Chen come along with him.
If Jiang Chen died here, he certainly wouldn’t be able to provide a decent explanation for Feng Jingyang, and he would feel tremendously sad for the loss as well.
However, the situation was no longer under his control.
He didn’t even have the chance to speak.
Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign was serious about his decision.
The fact that Jiang Chen and Xiao Wangqing were heading into the terrifying gales was already unchangeable.
“What should I do?
Junior Brother Jiang is being too reckless.” Yu Huafan spoke worriedly.
“There’s no need to worry.
Jiang Chen never do things that he has no confidence in.
In other words, he will be able to pass through those winds,” said Big Yellow with incomparable confidence, his face full of calmness.
“Alright, but I have no idea where you have gotten that confidence from.”
Yu Huafan sighed.
He knew that not even a Third Grade Great Sovereign could go through those winds.
Although he had been tremendously impressed by Jiang Chen’s capabilities, Jiang Chen was merely an intermediate Immortal Venerable, and the outcome of intruding onto the platform was imaginable.
However, Big Yellow’s confidence had relieved some of his concerns.
Currently, Jiang Chen and Xiao Wangqing were already standing at the edge of the grand formation.
Xiao Wangqing’s facial expression had changed entirely as he stared at the sea of winds, knowing that his body would be sliced to a million pieces if he rushed into it straightaway.
“Jiang Chen, step down now.
I, Xiao Wangqing, am willing to die in this trial.
You still have a bright future.
You don’t have to risk your life with me,” Xiao Wangqing said.
He really couldn’t bear seeing Jiang Chen follow him into the Myriad Wind Formation.
This was too unfair to Jiang Chen.
In order to realise his wish, he would rather sacrifice his life.
Jiang Chen, on the other hand, was a heaven-defying and promising figure.
If Jiang Chen died today, he wouldn’t be able to rest in peace.
“Senior Xiao, when did you learn how to nag like a grandmother?”
Jiang Chen smiled, and then grabbed Xiao Wangqing’s arm, heading straight into the grand formation with a swoosh of his body.
All of a sudden, countless terrifying winds in the form of dragons came from all directions.
Each wave of wind was as destructive as a giant blade, intending to cut the two intruders in half.
“Senior Xiao, I’ll enshroud you with my qi.
Based on my observation, this grand formation is at least a few dozen miles.
The deeper we go, the terrifying it will become.
You just follow by my side.
The energy radiating from my body will guide you.
Remember not to move at your own will, otherwise death is just a step away,” warned Jiang Chen in a serious tone.
“Okay.”
Xiao Wangqing nodded, and allowed Jiang Chen’s energy and qi to surround his body.
After entering the Myriad Wind Formation, he realised how terrifying these gales were.
Given his strength, he wouldn’t be able to get past a tenth of the distance.
He also realized that it was no longer meaningful to ask Jiang Chen to back away now.
Knowing that Jiang Chen was proficient in the Great Void Technique, it would be a mistake not to follow Jiang Chen’s order.
Furthermore, there was already no turning back for the two of them.
Although Xiao Wangqing had no idea whether they could get past the Myriad Winds and meet the saintess, he believed that he couldn’t die here.
What he needed to do now was to stay calm and do as Jiang Chen said.
Jiang Chen was a creator of miracles, which meant that they might really have a chance.
Countless eyes were now focused on the grand formation.
Heavenly Peng, in particular, was focusing on Jiang Chen unblinkingly, as if he didn’t want to miss a move of Jiang Chen.
Everyone was eager to find out how long those two can last.
“Once the Myriad Wind Grand Formation is provoked, it will attack like countless beasts.
How far do you think they can reach?”
“Jiang Chen is just an intermediate Immortal Venerable.
While Xiao Wangqing is just a newly-advanced First Grade Great Sovereign.
In my opinion, I’m afraid that they can’t even reach the tenth of the formation.”
“I have the same thought.
It’s already considered not bad if they can travel roughly a tenth of the distance of the grand formation.
It’s virtually impossible for them to get past the entire formation, unless a miracle happens.”
Comments and remarks filled the air.
To them, this show was so much better than the previous singing and dancing.
It was a real eye-opener to them.
In the grand formation, Jiang Chen’s sparkling eyes gazed into the depths of the myriad of gales while circulating the Great Soul Derivation Technique and Great Divination Art.
Of course, the Great Void Technique was the ability he needed to get past these winds.
Through the Great Divination Art, he was able to calculate the trajectories of these winds, which would allow him to get pass every wave of wind with ease.
After a moment of observation, a faint smile could be seen on his face as he had already discovered all the tracks and arrangements of the wind waves.
Next, he only needed the Great Void Technique to get past them.
To an outsider, getting past the formation was as difficult as climbing the sky, but this was nothing to Jiang Chen who possessed the Great Void Technique and Great Divination Art.
He knew that this was a test from Heavenly Peng.
He also knew that Heavenly Peng was extremely familiar with the Great Void Technique.
The fact that Heavenly Peng asked him to get past the grand formation indicated that as long as he had mastered the Great Void Technique, he would be able to get through the winds with ease.
“Senior Xiao, let’s go.”
Jiang Chen moved, seals forming below his feet.
Moving like an agile dragon, bringing Xiao Wangqing along, he travelled three miles in a blink.
Neither of those gales of wind touched the two of them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1973 - Incredibly Startling
paragraphs: “Good.”

Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign’s eyes brightened when he saw Jiang Chen’s movement technique. He was finally convinced that Jiang Chen had mastered the Great Void Technique. There was no doubt that Jiang Chen was a descendant of Void Sovereign.
“What’s that movement technique? How could he move so fast?”

“What an incredible technique! It seems as though he could find the tracks of the gales. His movement was so light and nonchalant. Despite being only an intermediate Immortal Venerable, he was able to travel three miles within the grand formation in an instant. I wouldn’t have believed this if I didn’t see it with my own eyes.”
“That’s the Great Void Technique acquired by that bastard when he was in Golden Horizon.”

Numerous people were astonished by Jiang Chen’s movement technique. Each of them was an expert. Even though they were unable to identify the technique, they couldn’t deny its amazing speed. Plus, it was unbelievable that Jiang Chen was able to remain intact within the myriad of winds.
“Great Void Technique! Can’t believe that’s actually the Great Void Technique of Void Sovereign. No wonder this kid is confident in venturing into the Myriad Wind Grand Formation.”

“Incredible. The Great Void Technique is an unmatched technique. Void Sovereign had left an incredible legacy by relying solely on the Great Void Technique. He was almost on par with Immortal Execution King, Great Sovereign Zang Xian, and Golden Sovereign. This Jiang Chen is truly lucky to have gotten the inheritance of Void Sovereign.”

“Humph! So what even if he knows the Great Void Technique? The deeper they go into the formation, the more dangerous it is. Plus, it’s several dozen miles long. One should know that Jiang Chen is merely an intermediate Immortal Venerable. Even if he has obtained the Great Void Technique, he won’t be able to grasp the true essence of the Great Void Technique. I don’t think there’s anyone in this world that can easily master the technique created by Void Sovereign.”

“Yes. Even if Jiang Chen is able to use the technique, I’m afraid that he has only exerted less than a tenth of it. His current condition is still very far away from the actual Great Void Technique, however I would like to see how he’s going to get through this grand formation.”
Everyone was shocked except for the experts of the three Immortal Courts, who had known about this long ago.

Acquiring the Great Void Technique and mastering it were two different concepts. As the Myriad Wind Grand Formation was too terrifying, no one believed that Jiang Chen could get through it. He might not move as freely the moment he reached the center of the formation.
“Amazing! Never thought that Junior Brother Jiang has such means. He has actually obtained the inheritance of Void Sovereign.”
A hint of a smile appeared on Yu Huafan’s face. Most of the concerns on his face were relieved the moment he saw Jiang Chen’s movement technique.

Across the entire Immortal World, there was no one who didn’t know who Void Sovereign was. He was an ancient Great Sovereign that could venture anywhere in the Immortal World at will, left an extraordinary legend and was as famous as those ancient overlords. Many people said that only the lucky one could acquire the inheritance of Void Sovereign. Therefore, most of the youngsters seemed pretty envious of Jiang Chen right now. Despite being rare geniuses in their domains, they hadn’t obtained the recognition of Void Sovereign.
In the grand formation, Xiao Wangqing was following Jiang Chen from behind carefully.

“Senior Xiao, I might as well tell you this, I have already memorized all the traces of the gales in the formation. You only need to be patient. Soon, you and the saintess will meet again.” Jiang Chen turned his head and said with a smile.
“Jiang Chen, you are undoubtedly a miracle.”

A smile appeared on Xiao Wangqing’s face. His despairing heart was now filled with brilliant hope. He knew that Jiang Chen wasn’t lying to him as Jiang Chen wasn’t a liar. Jiang Chen’s previous performance was already sufficient to prove his words.

However, he had no idea how Jiang Chen was able to memorize the trails of the gales so quickly. To him, Jiang Chen had created yet another miracle. What he needed to do now was to follow Jiang Chen’s words- stay close to Jiang Chen and remain motionless.
At this point, the energy and density of the gales intensified. This would be the furthest Xiao Wangqing could go if he was alone. Every step he took was going to be incomparably hard.
“Senior Xiao, let’s go.”
Jiang Chen smiled confidently. With a twist of his body, they travelled another three miles. And with another three twists of his body, they appeared a dozen miles away from their original position.
Jiang Chen seemed incredibly relaxed in the entire process. His clothes seemed unaffected by the strong gales as though none of the wind had touched him.
Moreover, he wasn’t travelling alone. He was bringing Xiao Wangqing with him, otherwise he would have reached his destination long ago.
“Impossible. This is absolutely impossible. How is he able to get through it so easily?”

“This is truly a miracle. Despite the fact that the grand formation was personally deployed by Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign, Jiang Chen seemed so relaxed and nonchalant while moving within the gales. More importantly, he is bringing along Xiao Wangqing. Did you all see that Xiao Wangqing has remained motionless from the start until now? He was entirely carried by Jiang Chen.”

“Sure enough, the Great Void Technique is truly the number one movement technique in the Heavens and Earth. It seems Jiang Chen has already mastered it. It’s rare to see an intermediate Immortal Venerable reaching such a level.”
“Now, it seems that Jiang Chen is very likely to get past the grand formation. Today, I’m going to witness the birth of a miracle.”
“Humph! Don’t conclude too early. He hasn’t even traversed half of the formation yet. You are only looking down on Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign if you speak in such manner.”

Everyone was startled by the unbelievable scene. This time, Jiang Chen’s performance would spread his name to the entire Immortal World and Demonic Immortal Island. Everyone would know who he is after this.
Each and every one of them were focused on the scene, eager to know the outcome—if Jiang Chen could really bring Xiao Wangqing past the Myriad Wind Grand Formation.

chapters.title: Chapter 1974 - Finally Meeting Again After 300 Years
paragraphs: On the high platform, Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign’s expression became more and more dignified, his eyes glittering with slight fascination. Jiang Chen’s movement technique seemed to have brought him back to his past.

Despite his resentment towards Xiao Wangqing, he was eager to know the outcome. What he wanted wasn’t a miracle, but a proof. He always admired the Great Void Technique vehemently. Although the speed of his Myriad Wind Grand Formation was close to the peak speed of the Heavens and Earth, he was sure that this was nothing to the master of Great Void Technique.

What he saw from Jiang Chen was an unparalleled shadow, which was sufficient to convince him that Jiang Chen was truly the descendant of Void Sovereign, otherwise, it would be impossible for an intermediate Immortal Venerable to be able to use the Great Void Technique so well.
Even Heavenly Peng himself was unable to detect a single flaw from Jiang Chen’s movement technique, because it was already near perfection.

All eyes were upon the grand formation. The two agile figures had already travelled half of the distance, though it was still unknown if Jiang Chen could successfully bring Xiao Wangqing past the formation. Despite that, the onlookers no longer had the thought that Jiang Chen and Xiao Wangqing would die for sure.
As the miracle was happening right before their very eyes, they couldn’t help gaping at it.
Within the grand formation, Jiang Chen showed no sign of nervousness despite the terrifying waves and violent roars of the wind dragons. Xiao Wangqing, on the other hand, seemed pretty pale.
The composure and confidence on Jiang Chen’s face greatly impressed him.
Everyone knew that the deeper one went into the grand formation, the scarier, denser and stronger the waves would become.

But in Jiang Chen’s point of view, the depths of the grand formation was no different than the edge of the formation. As he had already memorized all the trajectories of the waves, he could easily get past the gales through the smallest gaps between the winds. Therefore, the strength and density of the gales wouldn’t affect him.
*Swoosh!*

With a slight shake of his body, he and Xiao Wangqing moved 7 or 8 miles away from where they stood just a moment ago. The process seemed as easy and casual as before. Neither of the dense wind was able to touch them.

The onlookers exclaimed once again. Moments ago, Jiang Chen was travelling roughly three miles with his every move. Supposedly, his abilities should be weakened due to the density and intensity of the winds. The way he travelled so nonchalantly was too astonishing. No one would dare believe it if they didn’t witness it with their own eyes.
*Swoosh!*
However, before they could regain their senses, Jiang Chen and Xiao Wangqing moved another seven or eight miles again.

Currently, the two of them could already see the interior of the Myriad Wind Platform clearly. It was a towering platform the size of several dozen meters. On top of the platform was a huge green rock. Above the rock sat a beautiful woman in light blue feather clothes.
She seemed to be in her twenties. Despite being imprisoned for three hundred years and fatigued, her beauty was still unparalleled.
She was a country-toppling beauty. The melancholy on her face was pitiful. Although she wore no make-up, there wasn’t a flaw on her impeccable appearance.
“Yu Er...”

Xiao Wangqing called out to her with a shivering and hoarse voice. It had been more than 300 years and at last, they met again. Despite the composure of Xiao Wangqing, he was unable to control his overwhelming emotions.
When the woman heard his voice, her body shook as she turned her head quickly. She froze when she saw Xiao Wangqing through the gales.
She was gaping at them with disbelief. Seconds later, two drops of tears fell from her eyes.
“Beloved!”
She choked. Her body was shaking violently as this was like a dream to her.

Numerous onlookers rose to their feet when they saw the scene. No one had thought that Jiang Chen could really reach there. Now, there were only three or four miles left to the destination. It would only take a twist of Jiang Chen’s body to get there, but the winds within this distance was the strongest.
“My goodness! This kid is about to get past the grand formation by just using the Great Void Technique!”
“This is absolutely a miracle, however do you all think that he can really get to the destination in the end?”
“I’m afraid that he has already mastered the Great Void Technique. I guess that he will have no problem getting past the last distance.”

Everyone was shocked, their faces brimming with excitement, especially the experts of Demonic Immortal Island. They had been feeling sorry for the pain and suffering Xiao Wangqing and the saintess had to endure over the past three hundred years. They all hoped to see the two get together again and live happily.
Hence, they were no doubt delighted when Jiang Chen took Xiao Wangqing across the grand formation to meet the saintess.
“Senior, remain calm. I’ll bring you over.”
Sensing the emotional fluctuation of Xiao Wangqing, Jiang Chen feared that he would do something stupid like leaping across the gales, which would surely get himself killed instantly.
“En.”

Xiao Wangqing regained his composure, knowing that it was critical to remain calm at this crucial juncture. Although they had reached the final step, it was the most dangerous step of all. Any accident that occurred at this stage would be fatal.
“Let’s go.”
Jiang Chen’s qi shook, and in a matter of just a few blinks, they went past the final obstacle and arrived on the platform safely.
This tall platform was the safe zone surrounded by the myriad winds. Such a prison was undoubtedly one of the most terrifying in the Heavens and Earth.
The atmosphere outside the formation was filled with commotion. Everyone was now on their feet as they had just witnessed the birth of a miracle.

chapters.title: Chapter 1975 - Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign’s Change of Attitude
paragraphs: “My god! They really have gone past the formation in such a short period of time!”
“What’s more, they aren’t injured at all during the entire process.”
“It’s no doubt the Great Void technique. I’m afraid there’s only this technique that could allow one to pass through the Myriad Wind Grand Formation so easily.”
“This Jiang Chen is absolutely an unrivalled genius but unfortunately he isn’t in our Immortal Court.”
No one could remain calm. The birth of a miracle could always stir people’s emotions. After all, none of them thought that Jiang Chen could get through those myriad of winds even if he was alone.

Although Xiao Wangqing was a First Grade Great Sovereign, everyone knew that he was carried by Jiang Chen. Despite that, Jiang Chen was still able to walk across the grand formation with ease. Not even Xiao Wangqing was wounded in the slightest.
What could this be if it wasn’t a miracle? Which first class genius amongst the nine great Immortal Courts could do what Jiang Chen just did?

Even Lan Xian and Tan Jinye’s facial expression darkened incomparably, however they couldn’t help but admit Jiang Chen’s strength because they were certain that they couldn’t even travel half of the grand formation.

On the Myriad Wind Platform, the saintess, Tian Lingyu, stood up from the large green rock. Emotions surged inside of her. Despite being a First Grade Great Sovereign, she was unable to stop her body from shivering.

All these years, although being imprisoned, she didn’t stop cultivating. As she possessed the complete Heavenly Peng Bloodline, it wasn’t strange that she had reached the First Grade Great Sovereign realm. If it wasn’t because of her being imprisoned, she would have already become a Third Grade Demon Sovereign after three hundred years.
Xiao Wangqing and Tian Lingyu stared at each other, but remained silent as though they had forgotten how to speak, this was like a dream to them.
Jiang Chen let out a sigh. He could sense that they still loved each other very much even though it had been three hundred years. Such unreasonable passion was unshakable.
“Yu Er.”
Xiao Wangqing stretched out his trembling hands slowly to touch Tian Lingyu’s face.
“Beloved, I’m not dreaming, am I?”

Tears fell from Tian Lingyu’s eyes. She had dreamt of such a scene too many times, but she was sure that those were merely dreams that could never come true. She had been worrying for the safety of Xiao Wangling for three hundred years. After all, given Xiao Wangqing’s identity and status, it was too dangerous for him to offend Demonic Immortal Island.
Now, it seemed like her dad was true to his words. At least, Xiao Wangqing was still alive until now.
Overtaken by impulse, she leapt into Xiao Wangqing’s arms.
*Swoosh!*
A ray of light flickered and Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign emerged on the platform. His heart sank when he saw the reaction of the two.
“Demon Sovereign.” Jiang Chen clasped his fists.

Xiao Wangqing and Tian Lingyu quickly separated from each other and greeted Heavenly Peng. Tian Lingyu apparently didn’t seem as respectful as the rest. After the greeting, she turned and walked away, seemingly uninterested in speaking to Heavenly Peng further.
Heavenly Peng had grown accustomed to his daughter’s coldness. Although Heavenly Peng had concealed it well, Jiang Chen could detect a hint of melancholy from his eyes.
This was understandable. After all, Tian Lingyu was his beloved daughter. No father would wish a distant relationship with his daughter.
Immediately after, his eyes fell upon Jiang Chen. There was an enormous change in his expression.
*Hua La!*
Heavenly Peng waved, sending out a shield of light that enshrouded him and Jiang Chen, entirely isolating them from the outside world.
Jiang Chen knew that Heavenly Peng needed to talk to him in person. He was certain that Xiao Wangqing and Tian Lingyu couldn’t know about it.
“Jiang Chen, it seems you have really acquired the inheritance of Void Sovereign, otherwise you wouldn’t be able to display the Great Void Technique so perfectly,” said Heavenly Peng.

“Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign, I could also see a trace of the Great Void Technique from your body. Does Demon Sovereign have any connection with Void Sovereign?” Jiang Chen asked. This was something he had been eager to find out.

He wasn’t afraid of Heavenly Peng, or being forced to hand over the Great Void Technique because he didn’t sense any hint of hostility from Heavenly Peng’s eyes. Secondly, he believed Big Yellow’s words without a shadow of a doubt. Things wouldn’t have gone so well if it wasn’t for Big Yellow’s secret guidance.

“Good eyesight. It’s truly a miracle that there’s someone as talented and young as you. Your future achievements are going to be immeasurable, Jiang Chen. However, the technique I’m using isn’t the Great Void Technique,” praised Heavenly Peng.

“Many years ago, when I was still a small Heavenly Peng, I was once guided by Void Sovereign. That is why you were able to sense a trace of the Great Void Technique from my movement technique. If it wasn’t for the guidance of Void Sovereign, I wouldn’t have achieved so much today. Void Sovereign is the greatest benefactor in my life. So my emotions were stirred when I saw you display the Great Void Technique,” Heavenly Peng continued, entranced in the memorable events of the past.

After hearing this, Jiang Chen finally understood why Heavenly Peng had paid such a huge attention to the Great Void Technique. He was deeply indebted to Void Sovereign for the guidance he had given to him.
Speed was the strength of Heavenly Peng, but without the personal guidance of Void Sovereign, he wouldn’t have become what he is today. There wasn’t a single doubt about this.

Big Yellow must have known about this secret. This explained why he knew that the Great Void Technique would attract the attention of Heavenly Peng, which was normal because he was once a figure on par with Void Sovereign in his past life.

chapters.title: Chapter 1976 - Being on Intimate Terms
paragraphs: “I didn’t expect that there was such a connection between Demon Sovereign and Void Sovereign, but there’s one thing that junior doesn’t understand,” said Jiang Chen.
“Tell me more.”

Heavenly Peng felt that Jiang Chen was more and more pleasing to his eyes. Putting aside the fact that Jiang Chen was a descendant of Void Sovereign, the fact that Jiang Chen could get past his Myriad Wind Grand Formation was already sufficient to impress him.

“Since Demon Sovereign had such deep affinity with the Great Void Technique, why did Demon Sovereign not ask this junior to pass over the technique? After all, the Great Void Technique will certainly bring tremendous benefits to Demon Sovereign’s cultivation. Demon Sovereign may even break through to the Seventh Grade Great Sovereign realm after that.” Jiang Chen spoke straightforwardly as he was a man who didn’t prevaricate.
Heavenly Peng was impressed once more by Jiang Chen’s forthrightness.

Furthermore, Jiang Chen had shown neither humility nor pride. He behaved so naturally even in the face of Demon Sovereign. Any ordinary youngster would’ve felt incredibly nervous, and would think twice or even thrice before they spoke.

Because of this, Heavenly Peng instantly grew fond of Jiang Chen. Of course, this started from the impression that Jiang Chen was a descendant of Void Sovereign. Also, the extraordinary performance of Jiang Chen proved the extraordinary eyesight of Void Sovereign.

“Jiang Chen, it seems like you still don’t know about it yet. Although everyone yearns to cultivate the Great Void Technique, not everyone is able to practice this secret technique. One must have tremendous affinity with Void Sovereign in order to cultivate it. In the past, Void Sovereign only provided me with guidance, but didn’t pass down the Great Void Technique to me. This is sufficient to show that I wasn’t his descendant, thus not eligible to cultivate the Great Void Technique,” said Heavenly Peng with a smile.

“The Great Void Technique you used just now consisted of the thoughts of Void Sovereign. Only the one who is recognized by those trace of thoughts can become a descendant of Void Sovereign. Frankly speaking, if you weren’t recognized by Void Sovereign as his descendant, you wouldn’t be able to cultivate the Great Void Technique even if you have acquired it. In other words, it is pointless even if I force you to hand over the Great Void Technique, because I wasn’t chosen as a descendant.

“Moreover, I don’t requite kindness with enmity. I’m greatly indebted to Void Sovereign. Although everybody said that he fell during that catastrophe, I think otherwise. He’s the creator of the Great Void Technique. No one in the world could kill him. Over the years, especially after my great achievements, I’ve been looking for a chance to repay his kindness, but I couldn’t find any chance. Now that the descendant of Void Sovereign has come, I naturally will have to attach great importance to him.” Heavenly Peng told Jiang Chen frankly everything that happened in the past.

Jiang Chen could feel the tremendous change in Heavenly Peng’s attitude. Heavenly Peng was now treating him in a kind and friendly way as though they had known each other for a long time, however, he knew that this was all because of Void Sovereign.
He finally realised that he had become the true successor of Void Sovereign the moment he acquired the Great Void Technique.
“Jiang Chen admires Demon Sovereign’s sentiments and gratitude.” Jiang Chen clasped his fists and spoke sincerely.

It was extremely rare to find someone like Heavenly Peng. When one reached the top, one would lose one’s conscience easily. This was what happened to Star Sovereign who was once a follower of Heaven Sovereign in the past. After he became the lord of the Immortal Court, his mindset changed - he wanted to get rid of Heaven Sovereign.
There were numerous people of this kind in every era.

Heavenly Peng on the other hand didn’t forget his benefactor, although he knew that it was impossible to meet Void Sovereign again. Meeting the descendant of Void Sovereign today had fulfilled one of his important wishes.
“Brother Jiang Chen, if you don’t mind, you can call me Big Brother from now on.” Heavenly Peng clasped Jiang Chen’s shoulder and said.
What the hell!
Jiang Chen rolled his eyes and staggered. How crazy was the idea of calling Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign his brother?
“No, Demon Sovereign. What right do I have to become your ‘brother’?”

Jiang Chen waved and hastened to speak. This was too much for a joke. The gap of seniority between Heavenly Peng and him was just too great. Xiao Wangqing, who was the son-in-law of Heavenly Peng, was a senior he respected. If he called Heavenly Peng “brother”, Xiao Wangqing would have to call him “uncle”.
Dang! Jiang Chen hadn’t even thought of this!

“Brother Jiang Chen, if you don’t accept it, that means you look down on your brother. Because of Void Sovereign’s guidance in the past, I’m able to reach this height today. I’m considered? halfdisciple of Void Sovereign. As you are the true successor of Void Sovereign, it’s only logical for us to address each other as ‘brothers’. So what’s wrong with that? Or do you think that I’m not qualified to be your Big Brother?” said Heavenly Peng in a somewhat angry tone.

Waves of tempestuous emotions were rolling inside of Jiang Chen. He knew how important Heavenly Peng was. The nine great Immortal Courts wanted to build a good rapport with him. He hadn’t thought that he would be called “brother” of Heavenly Peng even in his dream.
However, he couldn’t refuse it because what Demon Sovereign said was reasonable. They were both disciples of Void Sovereign.
“Alright. Big Brother, please accept the salute from your Little Brother.”
Jiang Chen’s qi fluctuated as he clasped his fists. He wasn’t a punctilious person. It would only make Heavenly Peng angry if he declined the offer now.

Furthermore, countless people had dreamt of having such a close relationship with Heavenly Peng. Not even the nine Sovereign Lords were able to do so. Apparently, Heavenly Peng no longer regarded Jiang Chen as an outsider. This time, Jiang Chen benefited tremendously. Innumerable people were going to resent him once this news was spread.

chapters.title: Chapter 1977 - Xiao Wangqing’s Chance
paragraphs: Jiang Chen’s heart was filled with excitement. In spite of that, he still couldn’t entirely adapt himself to that feeling because having Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign as his big brother was equivalent to gaining a powerful assistance. His main purpose in going to Fengchi Immortal Court was to help Heaven Sovereign oppose Star Sovereign. However, since the forces of Star Sovereign was deeply ingrained in FengChi Immortal Court, and he alone possessed overwhelming power, it would be an arduous effort to completely overturn him.

All in all, if a true battle broke out in the future, having Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign’s help would surely be a good thing. With that thought in mind, Jiang Chen felt that his trip to Demonic Immortal Island this time was not in vain. Instead, it was a fruitful trip.
“Haha. Very well, Brother Chen. Today, you and me have become brothers. I’ve been hoping for it for years and it is now considered fulfilled. This is a gift from me. Take it.”
Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign burst into a hearty laughter, expressing his joy and happiness. His hand held an item and handed over to Jiang Chen.

Jiang Chen took a glimpse on the item which Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign passed to him, and discovered that it was the Vermillion Bird Divine Blood given by the Fengchi Immortal Court. Now, Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign intended to give it back to him. This unexpected outcome made Jiang Chen at a loss of what to do.

“Big Brother. This Vermillion Bird Divine Blood is what we presented to you as a gift. It has great benefits for you as it can help you to attain the Seventh Grade of the Great Sovereign realm. This gift of yours is too valuable for me. This little brother can never accept it.”
Jiang Chen rejected the offer. Although he had also coveted the Vermillion Bird Divine Blood for a long time, it now belonged to Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign.

“Brother Chen, you’re wrong. The Vermillion Bird Divine Blood sure is helpful to me. But unfortunately, my speed has already reached its limit. Even with the help of the blood, it is still difficult to improve it. Moreover, I plan to rely on my own ability to attain the Seventh Grade of Demon Sovereign without any help from external force. When I achieve the Seventh Grade, it means that I am already at a higher grade in the Great Sovereign realm. This step is extremely crucial. I must do it on my own. If I am able to do it, it will prove my ability to continue climbing to a much higher level. Furthermore, I, Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign, had never once take my gifts back. If you don’t accept it, it simply means that you look down on your Big Brother.”
As Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign spoke, his face turned gloomy, revealing a hint of anger on his expression.

Without any further hesitation, Jiang Chen grabbed the Vermillion Bird Divine Blood from Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign’s hand. He did not have the guts to underestimate his superior Big Brother. Since Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign had given him no other choices, there was no reason for Jiang Chen to be modest anymore.

With the Vermillion Bird Divine Blood in his hands, Jiang Chen was extremely happy. In fact, there was no reason for him not to be happy. A drop of Vermillion Blood Divine Blood was enough to enable him to directly break through to the late Immortal Venerable Realm. Perhaps, he might even reach the peak of the late Immortal Venerable Realm, without affecting his foundation.

Not only that, the blood contained a trace of blood vein of the Vermillion Blood. If Jiang Chen absorbed it, he could use the? dragon transformation skill? to refine the Flame of Vermillion Blood. Currently, his body also possessed the True Dragon Flame, True Thunder Flame, Qilin Saint Flame and the Sun Flame. Taking the Divine Flame of Vermillion Blood into consideration, he would then possess 5 types of Supreme Flames. In short, the benefits he could reap from the blood was simply endless.
“That’s right.”
Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign’s lips curved into a broad smile. Perhaps, he was the only person who would feel so happy after giving away the Divine Blood of the Vermillion Bird.
“Big Brother. The passion and love that Xiao Wangqing and the saintess have for each other is truly touching. Has Big Brother ever considered to fulfill their wishes?”

Jiang Chen was unable to restrain himself from asking Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign, while taking a glance at Xiao Wangqing and Tian Lingyu who were outside of the light shield. Now, since he and the latter were treating each other as brothers, he really had to say something in order to help Xiao Wangqing get what he wanted.

Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign turned his head and looked at the couple whose faces were filled with bliss and happiness, especially Tian Lingyu. After more than three hundred years, it was his first time seeing her daughter beam with pleasure. As a father, it would be impossible for him to have no feelings about her daughter.

“Brother Chen, ah. I am not trying to be ruthless and heartless towards my own daughter. But? Yu Er*? is my daughter; the woman whom I dearly doted. My heart aches too for locking her up here all these years. I was waiting for her to change her mind and forget about that man. But now, it seems impossible for her to do so. However, the rules of our Demon Immortal Island can never be changed. They are set by the saintess of the first generation. Not even I have the right to go against it. As a member of the Demonic Immortal Island, every woman is disallowed to marry any foreign man, especially the saintess. The identity that Yu Er possesses is just too sensitive.”
Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign expressed his thought with a helpless expression.
“I have an idea that can satisfy both sides. I wonder if Big Brother is willing to listen.” Jiang Chen said.
“Please speak, Brother Chen.”
Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign’s eyes brightened up and stared at Jiang Chen.

“During my stay in Demon Immortal Island these past few days, I’ve noticed something. Although this island is a place for the demon race to gather, there are still some humans residing here. I believe that they had existed here before the Demonic Immortal Island was established and therefore, became members of the island, am I right?” Jiang Chen asked.

“Yes. Demonic Immortal Island was said to be inhabited by mostly humans at first. However, it was eventually occupied by the demon race, and the island was named ‘Demonic Immortal Island’. Even so, there are still some humans who continued to reside in the island. This is why you can see small groups of humans here. But we don’t repel their existence. In this island, be it human or beast, we are all one united group.”
Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign nodded his head when he explained.

“If that’s the case, it will be easy to handle. Since the women of the Demon Immortal Island are prohibited from marrying any foreign men, what about letting Xiao Wangqing join the island by making him one of the inhabitants of the island? If he is also a member of the island, then it will not be against the rules for them to be together. By doing so, the rule of the island is not violated; the conflict between you and your daughter can be resolved, and at the same time, the couple can live a blissful life. Isn’t it killing three eagles with a single arrow?” Jiang Chen shared his idea.

After hearing Jiang Chen’s words, Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign nodded his head in agreement. “Brother Chen, your idea is not bad. I can tell that you have a good relationship with Xiao Wanqing as you are willing to risk your life by entering into the Myriad Wind Platform. As such, I will give you face. As long as he is willing to join the Demonic Immortal Island, I will grant them their wish.”
“Thank you, Big Brother. Actually, Senior Xiao once saved my life. I owe him a favor and I promised myself that I will repay him someday.”
Jiang Chen smiled. The heavy stone within his heart was finally lifted. Deep inside, he began to feel grateful to Void Sovereign whom he had never met before.

If it wasn’t for him, it would be extremely difficult to settle the marriage of Xiao Wangqing and Tian Lingyu. Based on Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign’s temper, it is impossible for him to give me face.
*Hua La*

Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign waved his hand, and the shield that surrounded the both of them immediately vanished. They sauntered towards the couple. As soon as Xiao Wangqing caught sight of them, he quickly greeted them.
“Xiao Wangqing, today Brother Chen has pleaded for your sake. I am going to give you a chance.”
Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign opened his mouth and uttered.
Brother Chen? Who is Brother Chen? Don’t tell me it’s Jiang Chen. Is he joking with me?
Xiao Wangqing was rooted on the spot. His eyes involuntarily turned towards Jiang Chen who wore a broad smile on his face.

sentences.text: Jiang Chen’s heart was filled with excitement.
In spite of that, he still couldn’t entirely adapt himself to that feeling because having Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign as his big brother was equivalent to gaining a powerful assistance.
His main purpose in going to Fengchi Immortal Court was to help Heaven Sovereign oppose Star Sovereign.
However, since the forces of Star Sovereign was deeply ingrained in FengChi Immortal Court, and he alone possessed overwhelming power, it would be an arduous effort to completely overturn him.
All in all, if a true battle broke out in the future, having Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign’s help would surely be a good thing.
With that thought in mind, Jiang Chen felt that his trip to Demonic Immortal Island this time was not in vain.
Instead, it was a fruitful trip.
“Haha.
Very well, Brother Chen.
Today, you and me have become brothers.
I’ve been hoping for it for years and it is now considered fulfilled.
This is a gift from me.
Take it.”
Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign burst into a hearty laughter, expressing his joy and happiness.
His hand held an item and handed over to Jiang Chen.
Jiang Chen took a glimpse on the item which Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign passed to him, and discovered that it was the Vermillion Bird Divine Blood given by the Fengchi Immortal Court.
Now, Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign intended to give it back to him.
This unexpected outcome made Jiang Chen at a loss of what to do.
“Big Brother.
This Vermillion Bird Divine Blood is what we presented to you as a gift.
It has great benefits for you as it can help you to attain the Seventh Grade of the Great Sovereign realm.
This gift of yours is too valuable for me.
This little brother can never accept it.”
Jiang Chen rejected the offer.
Although he had also coveted the Vermillion Bird Divine Blood for a long time, it now belonged to Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign.
“Brother Chen, you’re wrong.
The Vermillion Bird Divine Blood sure is helpful to me.
But unfortunately, my speed has already reached its limit.
Even with the help of the blood, it is still difficult to improve it.
Moreover, I plan to rely on my own ability to attain the Seventh Grade of Demon Sovereign without any help from external force.
When I achieve the Seventh Grade, it means that I am already at a higher grade in the Great Sovereign realm.
This step is extremely crucial.
I must do it on my own.
If I am able to do it, it will prove my ability to continue climbing to a much higher level.
Furthermore, I, Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign, had never once take my gifts back.
If you don’t accept it, it simply means that you look down on your Big Brother.”
As Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign spoke, his face turned gloomy, revealing a hint of anger on his expression.
Without any further hesitation, Jiang Chen grabbed the Vermillion Bird Divine Blood from Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign’s hand.
He did not have the guts to underestimate his superior Big Brother.
Since Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign had given him no other choices, there was no reason for Jiang Chen to be modest anymore.
With the Vermillion Bird Divine Blood in his hands, Jiang Chen was extremely happy.
In fact, there was no reason for him not to be happy.
A drop of Vermillion Blood Divine Blood was enough to enable him to directly break through to the late Immortal Venerable Realm.
Perhaps, he might even reach the peak of the late Immortal Venerable Realm, without affecting his foundation.
Not only that, the blood contained a trace of blood vein of the Vermillion Blood.
If Jiang Chen absorbed it, he could use the? dragon transformation skill? to refine the Flame of Vermillion Blood.
Currently, his body also possessed the True Dragon Flame, True Thunder Flame, Qilin Saint Flame and the Sun Flame.
Taking the Divine Flame of Vermillion Blood into consideration, he would then possess 5 types of Supreme Flames.
In short, the benefits he could reap from the blood was simply endless.
“That’s right.”
Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign’s lips curved into a broad smile.
Perhaps, he was the only person who would feel so happy after giving away the Divine Blood of the Vermillion Bird.
“Big Brother.
The passion and love that Xiao Wangqing and the saintess have for each other is truly touching.
Has Big Brother ever considered to fulfill their wishes?”
Jiang Chen was unable to restrain himself from asking Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign, while taking a glance at Xiao Wangqing and Tian Lingyu who were outside of the light shield.
Now, since he and the latter were treating each other as brothers, he really had to say something in order to help Xiao Wangqing get what he wanted.
Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign turned his head and looked at the couple whose faces were filled with bliss and happiness, especially Tian Lingyu.
After more than three hundred years, it was his first time seeing her daughter beam with pleasure.
As a father, it would be impossible for him to have no feelings about her daughter.
“Brother Chen, ah.
I am not trying to be ruthless and heartless towards my own daughter.
But?
Yu Er*? is my daughter; the woman whom I dearly doted.
My heart aches too for locking her up here all these years.
I was waiting for her to change her mind and forget about that man.
But now, it seems impossible for her to do so.
However, the rules of our Demon Immortal Island can never be changed.
They are set by the saintess of the first generation.
Not even I have the right to go against it.
As a member of the Demonic Immortal Island, every woman is disallowed to marry any foreign man, especially the saintess.
The identity that Yu Er possesses is just too sensitive.”
Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign expressed his thought with a helpless expression.
“I have an idea that can satisfy both sides.
I wonder if Big Brother is willing to listen.” Jiang Chen said.
“Please speak, Brother Chen.”
Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign’s eyes brightened up and stared at Jiang Chen.
“During my stay in Demon Immortal Island these past few days, I’ve noticed something.
Although this island is a place for the demon race to gather, there are still some humans residing here.
I believe that they had existed here before the Demonic Immortal Island was established and therefore, became members of the island, am I right?” Jiang Chen asked.
“Yes.
Demonic Immortal Island was said to be inhabited by mostly humans at first.
However, it was eventually occupied by the demon race, and the island was named ‘Demonic Immortal Island’.
Even so, there are still some humans who continued to reside in the island.
This is why you can see small groups of humans here.
But we don’t repel their existence.
In this island, be it human or beast, we are all one united group.”
Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign nodded his head when he explained.
“If that’s the case, it will be easy to handle.
Since the women of the Demon Immortal Island are prohibited from marrying any foreign men, what about letting Xiao Wangqing join the island by making him one of the inhabitants of the island?
If he is also a member of the island, then it will not be against the rules for them to be together.
By doing so, the rule of the island is not violated; the conflict between you and your daughter can be resolved, and at the same time, the couple can live a blissful life.
Isn’t it killing three eagles with a single arrow?” Jiang Chen shared his idea.
After hearing Jiang Chen’s words, Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign nodded his head in agreement.
“Brother Chen, your idea is not bad.
I can tell that you have a good relationship with Xiao Wanqing as you are willing to risk your life by entering into the Myriad Wind Platform.
As such, I will give you face.
As long as he is willing to join the Demonic Immortal Island, I will grant them their wish.”
“Thank you, Big Brother.
Actually, Senior Xiao once saved my life.
I owe him a favor and I promised myself that I will repay him someday.”
Jiang Chen smiled.
The heavy stone within his heart was finally lifted.
Deep inside, he began to feel grateful to Void Sovereign whom he had never met before.
If it wasn’t for him, it would be extremely difficult to settle the marriage of Xiao Wangqing and Tian Lingyu.
Based on Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign’s temper, it is impossible for him to give me face.
*Hua La*
Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign waved his hand, and the shield that surrounded the both of them immediately vanished.
They sauntered towards the couple.
As soon as Xiao Wangqing caught sight of them, he quickly greeted them.
“Xiao Wangqing, today Brother Chen has pleaded for your sake.
I am going to give you a chance.”
Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign opened his mouth and uttered.
Brother Chen?
Who is Brother Chen?
Don’t tell me it’s Jiang Chen.
Is he joking with me?
Xiao Wangqing was rooted on the spot.
His eyes involuntarily turned towards Jiang Chen who wore a broad smile on his face.
Yu Er is also Tian Lingyu.
Er (儿) is a word especially used by parents to address their children.

chapters.title: Chapter 1978 - We Are One Family
paragraphs: “Senior Xiao, Brother Heavenly Peng and I have become sworn brothers. From today onwards, we are one family.”
Jiang Chen smiled as he spoke. He knew that it would certainly be a big blow to Xiao Wanqing, but he had to tell him no matter what. After all, it was already an unchangeable fact.
“What?!”

Xian Wanqing and Tian Lingyu cried out in alarm and staggered to their feet, as if they were going to fall on the ground. They widened their eyes and looked at Jiang Chen, and then shifted their gaze to Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign, feeling amused by what Jiang Chen had said. But judging from the expressions of the both of them, Jiang Chen seemed to be telling the truth.

Jiang Chen and Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign became sworn brothers? This joke had gone a little too far. Xiao Wangqing and Tian Lingyu could not accept it for a moment. The two of them knew the Demon Sovereign all too well. The Sovereign was known for his aloof and proud attitude. In other words, there weren’t many people that could gain his attention and respect. Even the Lords of the Nine Immortal Courts who tried very hard to cozy up to him were ignored by him.
Now, how could Jiang Chen, an intermediate Immortal Venerable Realm kid, able to become sworn brothers with Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign? What on earth happened to the world?
“Jiang Chen, is this true?”
Xiao Wangqing could not believe it.
“Precisely. If we follow the seniority in the family, I guess you need to address Brother Chen as uncle in the future.”
Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign was the one who answered.
Uncle Chen??
What the f**k??

After hearing what the Demon Sovereign said, Xiao Wangqing almost spurted a mouthful of blood. Wasn’t it funny to have Jiang Chen as his uncle? Tian Lingyu who was standing beside him did not know whether to laugh or cry. Earlier, Xiao Wangqing had already told her about Jiang Chen. Thanks to him, Xiao Wangqing was able to intrude the Myriad Wind Grand Formation and reunite with her. Therefore, deep inside her heart, she was extremely grateful to Jiang Chen.

At this moment, Tian Lingyu’s eyes were directly staring Jiang Chen without even blinking. She really wanted to know how charming this young man was for making her father decide to call him his blood brother.

As Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign’s daughter, she understood her father more than anyone else. He was an arrogant, obstinate and hard-to-please person. In this world, there weren’t many people that could make him look at them in the eye. Up until now, only Jiang Chen was able to receive such a treatment from him. That alone was enough to prove that Jiang Chen was indeed an exceptional person. One thing she knew for sure was that her father had never addressed any one as his brother or even become sworn brothers with anyone for no reason at all. Not even the lords that were on par with him were considered as his brothers. That is to say Jiang Chen had done something that none of the nine lords could do.
“Big Brother, let’s not talk about seniority first. It would only make this little brother feel ashamed and embarrassed.”
Jiang Chen shook his head. He was also in an awkward situation where he didn’t know whether to be happy or sad. If Xiao Wangqing really addressed him as Uncle Chen, he might not be able to take it.

“Senior Xiao, I already talked with Big Brother earlier. The love between you and the saintess has really touched us. As such, Big Brother intends to give both of you a chance. The rules of Demonic Immortal Island must never be violated. So, only if you promise to join the Demonic Immortal Island from now onwards can we choose an auspicious day to hold the wedding ceremony for you and the saintess. After parting for more than three hundred years, the two of you can finally reunite. In the future, the two of you will be able to live a blissful life that you’ve both longed for.”
Jiang Chen opened his mouth and spoke what’s on Demon Sovereign’s mind.

As soon as Jiang Chen’s words faded, Tian Lingyu’s face was instantly filled with ecstasy, and she shot a hopeful look with tears welling up in her eyes towards Xiao Wangqing. She had been waiting for far too long for this day to come. But it truly was out of her expectation that her dream would come true today.
“I am willing.”
Xiao Wangqing promised without hesitation. For Tian Lingyu, he was willing to do anything even if he has to risk his life for it, let alone joining the Demonic Immortal Island.

Besides, Xiao Wangqing was a person who was cut off from others. To him, anywhere would be the same. The Demonic Immortal Island was the largest island in the sea. It possessed the strength to even compete with the Immortal Court. As such, it was not a disgrace for him to join the Demonic Immortal Island. Moreover, by doing so, he would be able to stay together with Tian Lingyu. Therefore, to Xiao Wangqing, staying at the island would bring him no harm; instead, he would be able to fulfill his biggest wish.

“Mm-hmm. Since you agree to it, from now onwards, you are now a resident of the Demonic Immortal Island. A few days later, I will personally host your wedding ceremony.” Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign spoke.
“Thank you, Father!”
Tian Lingyu suddenly knelt down on the ground with a flop, shedding a flood of tears. She did not imagine that this day would actually come true, not even in her dreams.
“Hai! Yu Er, finally, I can hear you call me ‘Father’ once more after all these years. Good. It’s good to hear it again.”

Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign let out a sigh. At this moment, it seemed like the unpleasantness between him and Tian Lingyu was completely reconciled. The deep feelings and love that a father and a daughter had for each other had finally returned and filled their hearts.
“Thank you, Demon Sovereign!”
Seeing Tian Lingyu reacting in such a manner, Xiao Wangqing also hurriedly expressed his gratitude towards Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign.
“Why? Aren’t you going to change the way you address me?”
The Demon Sovereign glared at Xiao Wangqing.
“Yes. Father-in-law.”

Immense joy was plastered all over Xiao Wangqing’s face. He turned and walked to Jiang Chen without uttering any words, then solemnly cupped his fist to show how indebted he was to Jiang Chen. Deep inside, he felt that he would not be able to repay Jiang Chen for the rest of his life.

He clearly knew that it was all because of Jiang Chen that he and Tian Lingyu would have such a happy ending. It was an undeniable truth. Although he did not know how Jiang Chen suddenly got so close to Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign, in his mind, Jiang Chen had just created another miracle.
This man was like a mystery. There is always a unique charm on him that was even able to make Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign be attracted to him.
“Haha. Very well. Today is my birthday. Furthermore, I have just solved a matter of mind. Two happy events had come right at the same time. Hahaha. Let’s go.”

Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign laughed heartily. With a wave of his sleeve, the Myriad Wind Grand Formation on the Myriad Wind Platform abruptly dispersed. The scene which was originally filled with the howling of the strong winds suddenly turned peaceful and quiet in a flash. Since Tian Lingyu had already regained her freedom, there was no need for the Myriad Wind Grand Formation anymore.
In a flash, Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign brought Xiao Wangqing and Tian Lingyu out of the Myriad Wind Platform and appeared at the tall platform where everyone gathered.
Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign’s return drew everyone’s attention to the Demon Immortal Square. Everyone at the scene thought that there must be a change in the ceremony.

At the moment, all of them were filled with confusion. They only saw Jiang Chen successfully passing through the Myriad Wind Grand Formation with Xiao Wangqing. As for what happened on the Myriad Wind Platform, none of them had any clue because of the Myriad Wind Grand Formation. But one thing they knew for sure when their eyes gazed upon the tall platform was that Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign had some words to speak.
“She is the saintess of the Demonic Immortal Island? She really is devastatingly beautiful, ah.”

“She’s indeed the most beautiful woman in the world. She was rumored to be imprisoned for more than three hundred years. It’s really unexpected that she is freed today. Apart from that, the Myriad Wind Grand Formation has disappeared too. Evidently, Heavenly Peng Demon Sovereign has changed his mind.”
“But no matter what, the rules of the Demonic Immortal Island can never be changed. I wonder how the Demon Sovereign would deal with Xiao Wangqing.”
Most of them saw the legendary saintess for the first time. None of them could maintain their composure after witnessing her angelic beauty.
